templates.name: Humans-in-Control Research Agent
templates.description: A Copilot Studio agent that runs a multi-checkpoint research pipeline with human intervention gates at each stage. The agent orchestrates a structured analysis workflow where researchers can review, revise, weight, and approve AI-generated findings at key checkpoints before the pipeline advances, ensuring human oversight of the entire research synthesis process.

templates.name: Customer Journey Mapper Agent
templates.description: A Copilot Studio agent that analyzes uploaded documents (research reports, transcripts, survey data) and generates comprehensive customer journey maps using the Anthropic Claude API. The agent performs dual-pass analysis with content selection, producing structured journey stages with touchpoints, emotions, pain points, and opportunities.
